small_port_candidate.description: Preserve current action and plugin ABI; port ordered rotation constraints into current private path processing, with explicit execution and success semantics. Candidate only, not yet built or validated.
small_port_candidate.existing_reuse: Current MPPI already stores full path and inversion prefix, with XY/yaw tolerance advancement; rotation support extends an existing mechanism.
integration_points: Path constraint detection and prefix advancement
Controller execution of yaw-only segment without skipping coincident XY poses
Final goal cannot succeed before ordered path is exhausted
Rotation counts as progress; preemption/cancellation resets segment state
Planner and smoother preserve explicit rotation segments; collision checks cover sweep
small_port_candidate.scale: Bounded multi-file source port appears feasible; no basis to require whole-stack upgrade. Not equivalent to parameter-only change or proven one-day delivery.

unresolved: Snapshot component truncates an example 90-degree rotation to a 30-degree prefix; subsequent full execution was not tested.
Two-pose same-XY rotation is not cropped in this helper; this alone does not establish whole-controller failure.
No ControllerServer lifecycle, DDS, closed-loop, ARM, or physical acceptance.
judgement: A targeted backport may be modest; whole upstream architectural refactor is broader and unnecessary to demonstrate the behavior. Compatibility mismatch is not a reason by itself to reject the approach.
